one_liner: Email-first help desk with inboxes, live chat, knowledge base, reporting, and apps.
access_notes: Create an OAuth2 app in the UI for Inbox/Chat; Docs API uses user API key via Basic; configure Webhooks in-app.
blocker_notes: API access requires a paid plan; reporting endpoints gated to Plus/Pro.

evidence.quote: This is an HTTPS-only API and it uses OAuth 2.0 authorization, implementing Authorization Code and Client Credential flows. … You need to create an OAuth2 application… Your Profile > My apps and click Create My App.
Authentication is based on API keys… The API key is passed via HTTP Basic Authentication and goes in the username field. A dummy password, such as X, goes in the password field.
Each webhook includes two Help Scout headers… X-HelpScout-Signature: The computed signature… To verify… compute the HMAC hash and compare it to the header value…

Each paid Help Scout plan has different levels of API access… Standard | Up to 200 calls per minute | No access to reporting endpoints … Plus | Up to 400 … Pro | Up to 800 … The Free plan does not include access to the API or integrations.

Help Scout MCP gives AI assistants secure, official access to Help Scout data… This integration is available on the Standard, Plus, and Pro plans… Access is read-only for new connections.
The Chat API works with live Beacon chats… It is an HTTPS-only API using OAuth 2 and JSON… Chats sit under /chats on the same base as the Inbox API…
